content.text:
Implemented Linux-only swipe-to-seek feedback changes:

- **Removed the centered seek indicator on Linux** (`HeroFeedbackSurface.showSeekHud = false`).
- **During horizontal scrub**, the **bottom crumb/folder line** temporarily shows:
  - `target position / duration` and
  - **progress as a percent**
- **After the gesture ends**, the temporary crumb feedback **clears immediately**.

### Screenshots
- During gesture (shows seek target + duration + progress in bottom folder line):  
  `/.tmp/agent_shots/seek_scrub_during.png`
- Post gesture (seek feedback cleared):  
  `/.tmp/agent_shots/seek_scrub_post.png`

### Code changes
- `lib/widgets/hero_feedback_surface.dart` (added seek preview callbacks + disabled center HUD option + keyed seek GestureDetector)
- `lib/screens/void_screen.dart` (Linux: render seek preview in bottom crumb line; clear on gesture end)
- `dev/agent_service.dart` (harness fix: `dragByKey` now includes the keyed root; added support for `end=false` so we can screenshot mid-gesture)

content.text:
Implemented Linux-only swipe-to-seek feedback changes:

- **Removed the centered seek indicator on Linux** (`HeroFeedbackSurface.showSeekHud = false`).
- **During horizontal scrub**, the **bottom crumb/folder line** temporarily shows:
  - `target position / duration` and
  - **progress as a percent**
- **After the gesture ends**, the temporary crumb feedback **clears immediately**.

### Screenshots
- During gesture (shows seek target + duration + progress in bottom folder line):  
  `/.tmp/agent_shots/seek_scrub_during.png`
- Post gesture (seek feedback cleared):  
  `/.tmp/agent_shots/seek_scrub_post.png`

### Code changes
- `lib/widgets/hero_feedback_surface.dart` (added seek preview callbacks + disabled center HUD option + keyed seek GestureDetector)
- `lib/screens/void_screen.dart` (Linux: render seek preview in bottom crumb line; clear on gesture end)
- `dev/agent_service.dart` (harness fix: `dragByKey` now includes the keyed root; added support for `end=false` so we can screenshot mid-gesture)
